parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates traveler-facing exposure: federal binary passport policy, visa cable directing refusal on document discrepancy and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility, federal facility ban, and documented federal/immigration-custody abuse including hormone removal, forced labour and sexual abuse, alongside official threat-framing of pro-trans groups. No trans-presentation criminalisation and courts have enjoined some orders. The state mitigates locally with constitutional equal protection, public-accommodation anti-discrimination law, gender-identity hate-crime penalties and a hotline, X state IDs, care coverage and a 2023 correctional-protection law, and is rated low-risk nationally. However no enforcement outcomes are documented, custody/healthcare shortfalls remain, bathroom status is unresolved, and federal border/facility/custody exposures are not neutralised by state tolerance.
